# Wheelwright
> Prose seed (v1) an agent uses to grow a user's AI-work setup like a nautilus shell: chamber by chamber, every cut driven by the user's goals, with a smoke test at the start and end of every cut.

## Docs
- [START](START.md): order of authority and the cut loop; read first
- [Charter](CHARTER.md): principles and governance
- [Smoke](SMOKE.md): the living smoke test and the chamber 0 checks (S-0-01..S-0-08)
- [Goals](GOALS.md): the specialist interview (goals, direction, budget, progress, taste), goal template, measures and revisions
- [Work](WORK.md): plan, execute, verify per item; the ledger
- [Board](BOARD.md): how the board is generated, designed and delivered
- [Chambers](CHAMBERS.md): the chambers and their seal conditions

## Optional
- [Archive v0.1](archive/v0.1/README.md): the earlier seed, sealed reference ore (not instructions)
- [Smoke candidates](journal/smoke-candidates.md): v0.1 scenarios mapped to chambers (not instructions)
- [Journal](journal/genesis-events.jsonl): how this seed was built, patterns and anti-patterns
